## Why
OntoKin's current direction is semantic object authoring and checked transport. Existing normalized construction records and GLB metadata already provide most of the architecture, but there was no finite sidecar contract binding supported meaning to an exact accepted source closure and delivered geometry.

## Changes

- Adopt the dated scope decision in current README, GOAL, STATUS and navigation; preserve previous goals, frozen C201 instructions, closed C199/C200 schedules and failed evidence. C209 job/0.2 work and further C201 admission are explicitly deferred.
- Add opt-in ontokin.semantic-export/0.1 for the finite construction-primitives/0.1 profile. Reuse existing model, compiler, Agent/0.2 and GLB/0.2. All 192 preexisting runtime Python files remain unchanged.
- Execute a real keyed-rack parameter edit from 0.65 m to 0.75 m, with stable unrelated identities/geometry, failure/retry handling, accepted-artifact preservation, deterministic regeneration and explicit unsupported-feature rejection.
- Retain independent source/artifact and transcript controls, Khronos/Three.js checks, browser captures, original failures and an honest regression disposition. No new receiver, Unreal integration, live physics or broad authoring advantage is claimed.

## Validation

Exact executed candidate: 7feb0dc501d3a6995732637f38c3c3b651914f4b. Reviewed publication: 957146d35d64330eca6fe30b1389bb7bd9f1780e, tree 918e398081a70e199e3ae0e29cdea559363397ce. Executable inputs remain equal; later changes retain evidence, documentation and the main lease.

- 275/275 predefined affected tests passed: 262 existing methods in 18 complete modules, including all 128 C01–C20 required IDs, plus 13 new methods.
- 54 actual Agent workflow checks and 68 independent controls passed.
- Both GLBs: zero Khronos errors/warnings. Separate Three.js and actual Chromium checks each passed 252 finite pose comparisons; four captures were inspected.
- Core source: 43 cases / 694 assertions; Agent: 10 cases. Other local procedural runners completed, preserving 16 pending external cases. Documentation preserved 29 original sources.

The mandatory broad local attempt is FAILED: 4,342 passed methods, 91 method errors, 221 real methods without outcomes, and 7 separate failed-import placeholders; the unit process stopped at 900 seconds. Representative failures from every error group reproduce on exact pre-C210 94dee707 source: the unchanged driver's copy omits 42 frozen fixture files, and default bytecode creation conflicts with the frozen independent-reader guard. Root lease/evidence changes also tripped the wrapper's source-stability guard; isolated immutable inputs match the candidate. The global failure, unrun methods, original torque result and C208 timeout/separate pass are retained. This is scoped experimental integration under OK-ENG-009, not a full regression or release pass.

Independent review found no introduced functional failure in the observed groups. Actual resulting-main affected/core/documentation checks and exact-input verification remain required immediately after merge. No paid hosted CI was enabled or awaited.

Scope ownership: #152. Close only after resulting-main verification. Then deliver the complete verified offline handoff and stop; the next session may select one pinned Blender receiving proof.
